description:
Imagine opening your laptop to a pull request that wrote itself overnight and a backlog that is already triaged. That is a normal morning with the GitHub Copilot app. In this video, watch a GitHub engineer automate their morning triage using the GitHub Copilot app: scheduled workflows, a daily brief, and MCP server integrations that surface prioritized issues and cut the noise before the day starts. 

#GItHub #GitHubCopilot #AI
